appliesTo: Professor-accepted jQuery source artifacts; identities below are the observed GitHub copies, not a claim about unlocated uploads.

fastPath.unchanged: Reuse Professor's acceptance. Check exact Git blob identities and JavaScript syntax once per changed PR, not on every chat handoff.
fastPath.changed: Check the delta and affected tests only. Keep previous accepted fingerprint for rollback.
fastPath.missingUpload: Reuse Professor acceptance as a decision, but do not claim possession or verification until exact files and hashes are located.
fastPath.publicationOrPrivilege: Separate runtime, credential, external network, production, agent activation, or distribution approval remains required.
